name: coder-gate-v2
description: MLLM Coder v2 (relay/runs/2026-09-14T17-25-10-314Z/deliverable.md). Reuses every v1 role (chains/coder-gate-v1.json) unchanged - one diff/one hunk governed unit, external propose/build, no write tool, unanimous critic signoff. The only thing v2 adds is interchangeability of which model/router fills a seat, expressed entirely in this file's seat entries: `seats.criteria` uses shape 1 (a plain model id, byte-identical to any other chain's seat), `seats.critics[0]` uses shape 2 (`extra.models`, OpenRouter's own provider-array fallback field - transport-failure-only, sequenced OpenRouter-side), `seats.critics[1]` uses shape 3 (the Pareto Code router slug in `model` plus `extra.plugins` configuring it). All three shapes validate against config/seat-model-schema.json. No new selection/fallback logic exists anywhere in this project for any of the three - src/chain.js and src/tools.js are untouched, and src/providers.js needed no change either (test/openrouter-adapter-capabilities.test.js, IN-1, found the adapter already forwards `extra` verbatim). Proposer and critic seats stay different labs per docs/coder-gate-diff-format.md's write-boundary note and this plan's §5 (judge-bias grounding, arXiv:2510.24367) - a routed seat's real, response-time model (visible in OpenRouter's own response `model` field) is still a single lab's model, never mixed with the proposer's.
